guide: Write the flow as an XCUITest: one `final class` subclassing QAStoryboardTestCase (Kiteloop/KiteloopUITests/QA/QAStoryboardTestCase.swift; read it and KiteloopQASmoke.swift first). Register the new file with `./scripts/qa/register-ui-flow.py <its path>` — an unregistered file never runs. Wrap each QA-procedure step in step("<what the person sees>") { … } so its screenshot is taken, and assert what the step promises inside it. The app runs in UI-testing mode against a mock agent: launchAndOpenProject(), sendMessage(_:) and waitForResponse(containing:) in KiteloopUITests.swift drive it, and a reply the feature needs comes from a scenario in Kiteloop/Kiteloop/Testing/UITestingSupport.swift (add one, selected with app.launchEnvironment["UI_TEST_SCENARIO"]). Never run `xcodebuild … test` yourself: the run command builds a separate QA copy so the running Kiteloop is untouched.
